about: MongoDB 7 as a single-node replica set (transactions work). Exports MONGO_URL.

docker.init: docker exec metaloop-{id} mongosh --quiet --eval "try { rs.status().ok } catch (e) { rs.initiate({_id: 'rs0', members: [{_id: 0, host: '127.0.0.1:27017'}]}).ok }"
docker.ready: docker exec metaloop-{id} mongosh --quiet --eval 'db.hello().isWritablePrimary' | grep -q true

requires.install: install and start Docker Desktop (or another Docker engine)

native.init: mongosh --quiet 'mongodb://127.0.0.1:{port}/?directConnection=true' --eval "try { rs.status().ok } catch (e) { rs.initiate({_id: 'rs0', members: [{_id: 0, host: '127.0.0.1:{port}'}]}).ok }"

requires.install: brew install mongodb/brew/mongodb-community mongosh (macOS) · the MongoDB apt repository (Linux)
